title.narrative: Support to Haitian National Police School and National Police Academy

description.narrative: Amidst the ongoing instability and violence in Haiti, the capacity of the Haitian National Police to restore\nand maintain order is limited and challenged by insufficient personnel, lack of equipment, and insufficient resources to carry out police security operations. In 2023, the HNP had only 9,000 police officers to serve a population of 11 million. The Haitian National Police School and Police Academy lack the tools and infrastructure to adequately train police commissioners, inspectors, and new cadets, which impacts their abilities to effectively fight crime. Given this, the Haitian National Police has identified equipment and refurbishment for the Police Academy as a priority need. This Project will support the Haitian National Police to equip and improve infrastructure at the Police Academy, in order to build their ranks and expertise to effectively counter gang violence and regain control of the country.\n
